name: City of Tripp Fairgrounds Campground
note: Four pads on grass at the south edge of the Hutchinson County Fairgrounds, about 300 m from the city's other campground by the pool. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: City of Tripp campground page (trippsd.com/campground, read 2026-11-22) links 'Fairgrounds: https://portal.setyoursites.com/explore/campground/city-of-tripp-fairgrounds' beside the Park listing; Set Your Sites API (read 2026-11-22): 'City of Tripp Fairgrounds Campground', 4 Individual sites A-D, $25 (D $20), walk-up only, 1-14 nights, water/sewer/30+50 A; engine map (api.setyoursites.com/api/maps/cbdf4a89-...) draws the 4 pads as ~14-15 m lines at 43.23057-43.23071,-97.96461..-97.96413. Town-run public campground: no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: Esri World_Imagery 2026-11-22 (240 m frame at the engine's pad coordinates): open mowed grass south of the fairgrounds track road and ballfield, houses to the south-west; no water in frame, nearest drainage is a small creek >500 m east of town in a 2.6 km frame. Imagery predates the pads. --Claude
